scope_note: Closed means the p4-owned draft portion exists, subject to review; FR-B01 mechanism/type closure remains with p5. No owner question or ADR is accepted.

assumes.assumed: Uniform semantic steps plus pinned input-size kernel tariffs are the recommended draft form.
assumes.if_other: Weighted primitives need another execution version, key, fixtures, chapter 05 compatibility treatment and the owner route decision.

assumes.assumed: Owning handles, including aliases, each count their full logical payload; explicit drop/scope exit releases them.
assumes.if_other: Conservative scope or run retention changes peaks and cut-offs and needs a new contract identity and vectors.

assumes.assumed: Children run serially with ancestor meters and optional caps; parent and child use is counted once.
assumes.if_other: Disjoint reservations or parallel children need fixed joins, deterministic return/aggregation rules and a separate reviewed version.

assumes.assumed: sha256-counter-draft-1, its sealed seed/path derivation and block vectors are a proposed generator contract.
assumes.if_other: A stateful or different counter generator needs a new algorithm identity, stream rules and vectors; no saved seed is silently reinterpreted.

assumes.assumed: Form 1 uses ApproxBool/display_if, charging its branch and selected pure body. LG2.20 owns the shared host-observation, exact-continuation isolation and DET.6 reproduction rule.
assumes.if_other: Form 2 uses LG2.21 and DET.64's specified display_enter/display_branch/display_exit lowering under lp1-exec-region-draft-1, with separate equality and one-short vectors. Exactness and owner policy remain separate.

assumes.assumed: Stops consume digest-bound half-open UTF-8 byte SourceRange from the handoff and p5.
assumes.if_other: Another coordinate contract needs explicit conversion and revised locator fixtures, not silent reinterpretation of offsets.

assumes.assumed: Text uses the shared scalar comparison rule; output counts canonical uncompressed bytes; logical memory stays separate.
assumes.if_other: Normalization/comparison tables or another output unit need distinct version pins and coordinated changes with p3 and p6.

assumes.assumed: The production canonical profile is supplied by p3 under chapter 05; vectors explicitly use PS1.2 retained JSON only as their test profile.
assumes.if_other: Other profile choices change exact output lengths and keys. Retain these fixture identities and add profile-specific product vectors; do not alter old stored bytes.

assumes.assumed: RT1 to RT3 retain the common semantic schedule; RT4 must lower to it or provide a checked equivalent host decomposition/mapping.
assumes.if_other: A different execution contract needs the owner route decision, separate identity, compatibility rules and its own vectors. This draft admits no route.

assumes.assumed: Meter the run-time flow checks inserted by the chosen checked form; examples only exercise a passing check and activate no reserved refusal.
assumes.if_other: Static-only labels or capability separation can require different sites and traces under a different pinned policy/lowering; the owner still selects the form and allowed flows.

assumes.assumed: Deterministic examples have no asynchronous cancellation and all inputs remain immutable.
assumes.if_other: Cancelling a pinned job after a revision change remains non-reproducible; allowing it to finish leaves this meter unchanged.

assumes.assumed: Unit and execution identities occupy existing ReproKey/RunRecord semantic fields; chapter 05 owns wire encoding and preservation.
assumes.if_other: A broader syntax/IR freeze or a different evidence carrier needs its corresponding profile and conversion, without granting an old key new meaning.

assumes.assumed: Only the packet's offline reference and closure checks run; the proposal does not authorize spikes or a freeze.
assumes.if_other: Deferring or authorizing experiments changes available evidence and ordering, not this draft's status or owner gates.

owner_items.why: One language/profiles, separate research language or product-only scope remains the owner choice (DET.39).
Allowed flows, display sinks, author classes and exceptions remain chapter 07 policy, not a meter decision.
Evidence facts/judgements and their summary rules remain open; a cut-off proves no absence.
Pinned jobs may finish or be cancelled after a revision change; this draft makes neither owner choice.
Language/native/per-tool built-in scope is not selected by the metering decomposition rule.
User-chart scope remains open; these rules impose accounting obligations on whatever scope is chosen.
No engine language is selected or evidenced here.
Only the owner selects route/placement or a different execution contract; mappings remain unverified (DET.22).
The owner accepts the data freeze scope; these semantic pins do not freeze bytes or syntax.
Sharing policy remains open and supplies no network permission here.
Any competence-dependent grant is an owner policy choice; the meter creates no grant.
No library or research scope is added, removed or accepted.
Spikes and their permissions remain owner decisions.
Freeze ordering and acceptance remain owner decisions; passing a closure check does not accept a draft.
Renderer handoff and precision choices are not selected; p6 must preserve exact fields and charge sizes.
The owner selects flow form and its static/run-time variant; this draft only accounts for its checked operations.
Both remain Proposed and unedited. Owner acceptance and the applicable gates are still required.

handoff_changes.change: DET.64 adds the necessary agreement condition for a predicate selecting a charged display branch. The one-step-plus-selected-branch rule is unchanged.
handoff_changes.why: H6 reconciliation retains predicate agreement because display accounting remains in DET.6 reproduction under LG2.20. Route implementers still owe predicate conformance evidence.

handoff_changes.change: DET.64 requires allowed approximate display variations to preserve canonical charged output length and unit boundaries; no alternative byte codec is defined.
handoff_changes.why: Variable-length approximate number encodings can otherwise change output exhaustion under one key. p3 and p6 must reconcile their producer/profile contracts.

handoff_changes.change: P7-lang reconciles the chapter 02 LG4.8 and chapter 11 metering/source summaries with DET.54 to DET.64. The still-Proposed ADR-L07/ADR-L08 descriptions remain p7-reg's reconciliation scope.
handoff_changes.why: The chapter summaries now identify specified working forms separately from outstanding mappings, production tariffs, evidence and owner freeze. No ADR is accepted by that update.

new_error_codes.meaning: An admitted pointwise assertion is false; stop the run as an error before its guarded operation, keeping admitted charges.
Seed size or scalar stream path/count/length is invalid under the declared generator contract.
An admitted draw requests a counter after the last defined block; no wrapping or repeated block.
Invalid UTF-8 or a surrogate would enter Text; no invalid value is bound.

integration_work.work: Review the combined production output/terminal profile and display predicate/size contracts against LG2.20, LG2.21 and DET.64; collect error and requirement rows/counts in chapters 12 and 13. H6 isolation and H7 coordinates are specified; executor evidence remains owed.
Review the current candidate independently under the project protocol before any commit; no review wrapper or network call is permitted inside this packet.

Supply concrete production row descriptors, tariffs, output reserve bounds and checked lowering for a selected candidate. The tariff values in vectors are test inputs, not recommendations or measurements.
Establish actual Windows/headless-Linux mapping, predicate agreement and display-output-size agreement. The abstract model is not executor conformance evidence.
